# p0_ai_gateway_log_provider (Resource)

A source of tool-call activity logs that one or more AI gateways share. P0 reads a gateway's
MCP tool-call activity from its log provider, and shows it in the Event Log.

To link a gateway to this log provider, use the `p0_ai_gateway_log_provider_link` resource.

P0 does not check that the logs exist when you create this resource. A missing or wrong source shows up only in the
Event Log.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Reads activity from the VictoriaLogs instance that the ai-gateway-stack chart
# runs next to the gateway. It needs no other settings.
resource "p0_ai_gateway_log_provider" "victorialogs" {
  id   = "victorialogs"
  type = "victorialogs"
}

# Reads activity from Google Cloud Logging. project_id is the project that
# holds the log bucket, which may differ from the gateway's own project.
resource "p0_ai_gateway_log_provider" "gcp" {
  id         = "gcp-logs"
  type       = "gcp"
  project_id = "my-gcp-logging-project"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) A unique identifier for this log provider
- `type` (String) Where the gateway's activity logs are stored:
    - 'victorialogs': the VictoriaLogs instance that runs next to the gateway. P0 reads it through the gateway's
      management API, so it needs no other settings
    - 'gcp': Google Cloud Logging, in the project that 'project_id' names

### Optional

- `project_id` (String) Required, and may only be used, if 'type' is 'gcp'. The GCP project that holds the log bucket
where the gateway's Cloud Logging entries land. This may be a different project from the one the gateway runs in.
